caribbean.headline: Roatan Faces Strong Winds, Heavy Rain Today
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing sustained winds of 28 kt and waves up to 5.0 ft, with a dominant ENE swell period of 9 s, and a 62% rain probability. St. Maarten will see winds up to 23 kt and less than 10% rain probability.

mediterranean.headline: Venice Braces for Heavy Rain, Mild Winds
mediterranean.paragraph: Venice is experiencing 100% rain probability, with maximum winds of 17 kt and waves reaching 2.3 ft. I note that Barcelona sees lighter conditions, with winds up to 9 kt and no significant wave height reported.
